messages:
Alex Kim: Quick follow-up from yesterday's PM: we need to assign owners for the remediation items and lock timelines. I'll start a tracker here — please ack and claim.
Mira Patel: Ack. I can take infra-related items (cache eviction, autoscaler thresholds). ETA: I can have proposed fixes by EOD Wed.
Raj Singh: Taking product-side action items (prompt validation, fallback policy). Will open the JIRA subtasks and link here.
Ben O'Connor: Oncall: I'll own monitoring/playbook updates and add alerts to reduce noise. Can someone confirm the alert thresholds we want? :thinking_face:
Alex Kim: Thanks. Tentative RACI: Mira (R) for infra fixes, Raj (R) for product changes, Ben (R) for monitoring. Sarah (A) for acceptance & rollout sign-off. Me (C) for coordinating with SRE. If this looks right react :thumbsup:.
Sarah D.: Acknowledged. I'll review rollout plan and sign off once docs and JIRA steps are in place.
oncall-bot: Incident bridge recording: https://meet.company/bridge/incident-1769 — recording uploaded.
Raj Singh: Created epic JIRA-3421 (postmortem remediation epic) and subtasks:
```
JIRA-3422: infra - cache TTL and eviction policy
JIRA-3423: infra - autoscaler tweak and load test
JIRA-3424: product - prompt validation + fallback
JIRA-3425: ops - alert tuning + runbook update
```
Link: https://jira.company/browse/JIRA-3421
Mira Patel: Claiming JIRA-3422 and JIRA-3423. I'll attach benchmarks and repro steps by Wed EOD.
Ben O'Connor: Claiming JIRA-3425. Plan: tune alert to reduce false positives by 60%, add a synthetic check that runs every 5m. ETA: Thurs midday.
Alex Kim: Quick note on recurring pattern: this looks similar to the March cache pressure incident (recurrence every ~3 weeks). Adding an action to add a recurrence check and a weekly dashboard spike review. Can we add a subtask for 'recurrence analysis'?
Raj Singh: Added JIRA-3426: recurrence analysis + long-term mitigation. I'll put a 2-week investigation window and tag infra/product owners.
Mira Patel: On the investigation: I'll include KV cache metrics and observe sequence length distributions. If we find pattern, propose a config auto-adjustment.
Sarah D.: For RACI clarity: please add the R/A/C names to each JIRA ticket description so handoffs are explicit — saves confusion during sprints.
Alex Kim: Agreed. Also we need a handoff timeline: owners to deliver PRs or mitigation plans within 2 sprints (14 days). If anything slips, escalate to the oncall rotation lead and CC me.
Ben O'Connor: Noted. I'll also add a small playbook snippet for fast rollback of the autoscaler change and add it to the runbook.
Raj Singh: Small ask: can product pair with infra on JIRA-3423 load test? Mira, want to pair tomorrow 10am?
Mira Patel: Yes, 10am works. I'll drop a calendar invite.
Alex Kim: Closing note: I'll consolidate these into the postmortem follow-up sheet and ping the broader list tomorrow AM with owners and due dates. Thanks all. :pray:
